[6:28AM] #Ikprodu
#Ogolonto
#TrafficUpdate

Good movement from Aruna but approaching Agric is very slow upto Aunty Kenny due to early morning rush coupled with the activities of commercial buses at the bus stop.

Moving down to Idiroko to connect Ogolonto down to Orita Aje is better but it's also a slow movement approaching Itowolo due to traffic emanating from Lagos road. 
The return journey is good to go.

Igbogbo and its environs are cool and calm from all sides.
 Connecting Ebute road inward Ibeshe roundabout is good but it's slightly slow approaching Police post.
Connecting Oba Sekunmade down to Ogolonto has nothing to worry about traffic wise.
Ita elewa axis is good on all sides at the moment.
#FollowLASTMA

Connecting the Third mainland bridge inward the Island is gradual flow.
